name: walk-up-trans-marker
body: Layout discovery and identity are independent: the suite tools find a project's apg/ by walking up from cwd, and the walked-up apg/.trans/ directory is the layout marker that resolves which graph a tool addresses (rust.apg.git: the walk-up apg/ discovery stays the layout resolver). Walk-up discovery stays unchanged; this change governs how the code identities inside the graph are spelled. A tool may find the main checkout's apg/.trans or a worktree's own branch .trans, and either way the stored identities are repo-relative and resolve against the project directory the tool is handed. The marker is a discovery aid, external to identity.
